proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
proposed_widenings.justification: On hit, the target emits Dim Light in a 10-foot radius until the end of the caster's next turn. No v4 atom covers a timed light-emission effect applied to a creature as an on-hit consequence. The closest candidates (grant_sense, apply_condition) do not capture light emission from a target creature.
proposed_widenings.evidence: until the end of your next turn, it emits Dim Light in a 10-foot radius

proposed_widenings.name: deny_condition_benefit
proposed_widenings.justification: On hit, the target can't benefit from the Invisible condition until the end of the caster's next turn. This is not removing the condition (remove_condition) nor applying a new one (apply_condition). It suppresses the mechanical benefit of an existing condition without stripping it. No v4 atom represents this operation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: can't benefit from the Invisible condition

notes: Partial encoding: attack_roll + radiant damage + cantrip scaling all fit cleanly (same shape as Chill Touch). The two on-hit riders (Dim Light emission, Invisible-benefit denial) are omitted because both require new effect atoms not present in v4. The encoded trace is honest about what it covers. See proposal-starry_wisp.md for widening detail.
